remarks: UTILITIES INCLUDED IN THE RENT   Welcome to this beautifully maintained and spacious rental in the heart of East Norwalk. Step inside to find stunning hardwood floors throughout, an open and airy layout, and an oversized primary bedroom that feels like a private retreat. The main living space flows seamlessly into a bright, updated kitchen and dining area-perfect for entertaining or relaxing at home. Outside, enjoy a fully fenced yard with an above-ground pool-ideal for summer lounging and weekend fun. Located on a quiet street just minutes from beaches, parks, shopping, and the train, this home offers both comfort and convenience. With plenty of natural light, storage, and style, this is the kind of rental that's hard to find and even harder to leave. Available now-don't miss your chance to call this place home.
